recommendation: Keep this no-change audit commit for FHIR-4000. No additional seed source edit is needed; handle FHIR-4002 under its own issue trail if desired.
issue_request: FHIR-4000 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for DSTU1 NutritionRequest/NutritionOrder and requested replacing supplement.name with supplement.productName because Product Name better represents the intent and differentiates it from Supplement.type.
initial_application: No standalone modern git commit explicitly tagged FHIR-4000 was found. The current NutritionOrder StructureDefinition carries a 2/4/2015 committee note for [#4000][#4001][#4002] saying to change ...name to ...productName, and the active element is NutritionOrder.supplement.productName.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively includes NutritionOrder in the current build. Later NutritionOrder refactoring preserved the supplement productName element while revising neighboring enteral formula and additive product-name elements. The same 2015 note also covers FHIR-4001, already represented on the combined branch, and FHIR-4002, a separate additive rename not decided here. No Zulip or Confluence evidence was found that changes the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Made no source change. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already names the supplement element NutritionOrder.supplement.productName, describes it as the product or brand name of the nutritional supplement, and current supplement examples either use productName or omit the optional element rather than using the old name.

related_jiras.note: The same historical committee note grouped the enteral formula name-to-productName rename with FHIR-4000; FHIR-4001 is already represented on the combined branch.
The same historical committee note grouped the additive name-to-productName rename with FHIR-4000, but that separate additive issue was not decided in this seed audit.
